validity.recommendation: No change to existence/classification. Segment IV is a real, actively-tracked project: a 4th parallel thread being added to the existing (40-year-old) Uzen(Zhanaozen)-Zhetybay-Aktau trunk gas pipeline, distinct from the capital-repair/modernization of the pre-existing 3 lines (a separate, unrelated project also reported in 2023).
validity.researcher_notes: Existence is well corroborated in Russian-language press, independent of gem.wiki/GEM: KazTAG (2022-07, paywalled/403 to fetch but title itself confirms scope), Turan Times (2023-02, 'construction of the 4th thread of the Zhanaozen-Aktau trunk gas pipeline will begin in 2023'), and two InAktau.kz articles (2023 and 2024-08) tracking the project's progress ('4 линия магистрального газопровода Жанаозен-Актау с точкой подключения к действующему МГ', contractor ТОО 'Транс Азия Констракшн', 46 km installed as of 2024-08-03). The pipeline's official/operator name is 'Узень-Жетыбай-Актау' per Intergas Central Asia's own site (obwaya-informaciya), which matches the sheet's StartLocation='Uzen' (not 'Zhanaozen') -- so that endpoint naming is correct, not an error. Classification as 'transmission' (trunk/magistral) is correct -- it is explicitly a 'магистральный газопровод' in every source, and is listed by Intergas Central Asia (QazaqGaz's dedicated trunk-pipeline subsidiary) among the lines it operates. No duplicate found against the 11-pipeline in-scope roster -- none of the other 10 rows describe this Mangistau Uzen/Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau corridor. Note for the orchestrator: the pre-existing 3 lines of this same corridor (in service since ~1980s, capital-repaired in 2023 per intergas.kz) are NOT part of this 11-row roster and may be a separate GEM entity outside this batch's scope -- worth a look in a future pass, but is not a duplicate concern for P5789/segment IV itself, which is specifically the NEW 4th thread.

validity.researcher_notes: The sheet lists Operator as АО «КазТрансГаз Аймак» (now rebranded QazaqGaz Aimaq), but that company's own materials (kase.kz prospectus, aimaq.kz rebrand notice) describe its core business as operating >69,000 km of gas DISTRIBUTION networks (transport-to-end-consumer, municipal/regional networks) -- a different function from trunk/transmission pipelines. Intergas Central Asia -- QazaqGaz's dedicated trunk-pipeline subsidiary -- explicitly lists 'Узень-Жетыбай-Актау' among the trunk pipelines it operates on its own site (intergas.kz/ru/obwaya-informaciya, verified, contains both 'Узень' and 'Жетыбай'), managed through its filial УМГ «Актау» (independently confirmed as a real registered Intergas Central Asia branch in the Kazakhstan government procurement registry, goszakup.gov.kz/ru/registry/show_supplier/389543, verified). Intergas Central Asia's own news desk (intergas.kz/ru/news/4/991) also reported on the 2023 capital repair of this same pipeline's existing 3 lines, consistent with it being the operating entity. Given PipelineType=transmission is correct, Operator should match the trunk-pipeline operator, not the distribution subsidiary. Tier is medium: the pipeline-to-branch link comes from Intergas's own site (a primary but self-interested source) corroborated by an independent government registry entry for the branch's existence (though that registry entry does not itself name the pipeline).

validity.recommendation: No change to SegmentCost. Keep the existing ref (lsm.kz) -- it does support the value; the sweep's automated existing_ref_check flagged it as failing only because it looked for the bare digit string '31600000000', which never appears verbatim in Cyrillic prose written as '31,6 млрд тенге'.
validity.researcher_notes: Manually reviewed https://lsm.kz/v-kazahstane-realizuyut-gazovye-proekty-na-106-mlrd-tenge (2024-01-22): it itemizes three specific budget-funded gas projects totalling 106 bn tenge, one of which is '...четвертой нитки МГ Жанаозен – Актау за 31,6 млрд тенге' -- an exact match for SegmentCost=31,600,000,000 KZT. Verified live via url_verifier with tokens '31,6'+'Жанаозен' (OK). Flagging for the record that this is a genuine ref-checker false negative (numeric-format mismatch), not a data problem -- worth relaying to whoever owns the automated value-check heuristics. Note the cost figure has moved over time as the project matured: KazTAG (2022-07, pre-tender) cited an early ~27.5 bn tenge estimate, and Turan Times (2023-02) cited a combined ~75 bn tenge figure shared between this project and an unrelated 3rd Aktobe-pipeline thread -- neither contradicts the final, itemized 31.6 bn tenge figure once the project was tendered/costed, so this is normal estimate-to-final drift, not a data conflict. Single strong specific source (no second outlet independently repeats the 31.6bn figure), so tier=medium despite the confident match.

fills.researcher_notes: Both outlets (Turan Times 2023-02-22, InAktau 2023-ish) independently confirm the 4th thread's construction start in 2023, matching the sheet's already-correct ConstructionYear=2023; a follow-up InAktau article (2024-08-03) confirms physical pipe-laying was already 46 km in by that date, consistent with a 2023 start (not merely 'proposed'). ConstructionMonth left blank -- no source gives a specific month.

Intergas Central Asia's own network list names the pipeline 'Узень-Жетыбай-Актау' -- confirming Uzen (not the town Zhanaozen) as the correct start-point name, and Aktau as the end point, both in Mangistau oblast, Kazakhstan. Independently corroborated by every press account of the project, which uniformly call it the 'Жанаозен-Актау' / 'Жанаозен-Жетыбай-Актау' trunk line running to Aktau.

Could not find an independent, citable primary source specifically confirming the Uzen field as this pipeline's gas feedstock (gem.wiki itself asserts gas is sourced from the Ozen/Uzen oil-and-gas field, but that cannot be cited per standing rule 1). Plausible given the pipeline's own name and the field's location, but per the fill rules I'm leaving this without a forced/fabricated ref rather than overstating confidence -- recommend a follow-up KMG/Ozenmunaigas-specific search in a later pass.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's own cited Status ref (tumba.kz) does not actually support 'proposed' -- the sweep's own pre-check already flagged it as not containing the word, and my own fetch of that URL returned an unrelated tourism article (a Karagiye/Sherkala day-trip piece), i.e. it is effectively a dead/misattributed citation for this cell, not merely a wording mismatch. Independent evidence shows the project moved well past 'proposed' years ago: construction start was announced/budgeted in 2022 (KazTAG, 403-blocked to re-fetch but title-confirmed) and 2023 (Turan Times, InAktau 3550779: 'В 2023 году начнут строительство' / 'реализуют проект'), and by 2024-08-03 InAktau (3812798) reports the contractor (ТОО 'Транс Азия Констракшн') had already installed 46 km of pipe, with the project description now 'undergoing design correction' ('идет корректировка проекта') and a revised target completion of 2025. Physical pipe-laying since 2023, still incomplete and under active revision as of the newest evidence found (2024-08), is squarely 'construction', not 'proposed' -- and no evidence of full completion/commissioning was found in searches through 2025-2026, so I am not proposing 'operating'. ConstructionYear=2023 already on the sheet matches this evidence and needs no change (see the paired fill). I did not set StartYear1: the only completion estimate found (2025) was explicitly flagged by the source itself as being revised, so committing a specific in-service year would overstate confidence. On the orchestrator's GulfPub note ('Tenge-Aktau operating, 152.89 km'): I believe that entry corresponds to the pre-existing 3 lines of this same corridor (in continuous service since roughly the 1980s, per the 2023 capital-repair coverage), not to the new 4th thread this row (segment IV) represents -- GulfPub recording an 'operating' status for the corridor as a whole is expected and does not contradict a 'construction' status specifically for the new, still-incomplete 4th line. Recommend a later sweep re-check for a 2025/2026 commissioning announcement.

summary: P5789 (segment IV, the new 4th thread of the Uzen/Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau trunk gas pipeline) is real and correctly classified; staged an attribution concern (Operator should be Intergas Central Asia, not KazTransGaz Aymak/distribution arm), confirmed SegmentCost=31.6bn KZT is actually supported by its existing ref (automated checker false negative), added refs for ConstructionYear=2023 and Location, left FuelSource UNRESOLVED, and proposed a Status change proposed->construction off 2023-2024 evidence of active pipe-laying (46 km installed by 2024-08, still incomplete).
